What's New in 1.5.5-beta5:
1. 2K QHD (2560x1440 / 1440x2560) Render Resolution:
   - Added KuroDisplay155 native display engine negotiating the highest-Hz 2K QHD (1440p / 2560p) hardware Display.Mode via WindowManager.LayoutParams.preferredDisplayModeId.
   - Configured WebView 2K @ 500 DPI viewport rendering (461 CSS px portrait / 819 CSS px landscape / tablet-safe wide DP / 1180 CSS px Desktop-Site Leanback) with live orientation sync.
   - Unlocked ExoPlayer 2K track selection (setMaxVideoSize(2560, 1440).setViewportSize(2560, 1440, true)), uncapped HLS level selection (capLevelToPlayerSize: false), upgraded WebGL2 shader pipeline (video-effects537.js) to 2K 1440p default output with up to 4x DPR support, and boosted Watch Screen poster/thumbnail decode & LruCache targets.
2. Forced 500 DPI Across All Screens & Dialogs:
   - Enforced Configuration.densityDpi = 500 and DisplayMetrics density = 3.125f across MainActivity, KuroOfflineActivity561, KuroDialogs581.themed(), Application resources, onConfigurationChanged, onResume, and immediately after every WebView instantiation (defeating Android Chromium's first-WebView-init DPI reset) regardless of system Display Size settings.
3. Restored Smooth Home Vertical Touch Scrolling:
   - Removed the beta4 window 'scroll' listener / data-k155-home-top lock in setupHomeEntryScrollGuard155() that fought Android WebView's native compositor touch scroll and caused Home to stay stuck at y = 0.
   - Preserved clean boot-at-top behavior via one-shot initial scroll reset, route-state538.js Home scrollTarget bypass, preventScroll focus options, shelf-scoped overflow-anchor: none, and touch-action: pan-x pan-y on horizontal carousels/rails.
